text.card: A red giant 2,677 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.07 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,762 K at its surface.
